source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed advertised specifications in a consumer product performance report

1. Start with the test records.
2.
completion:
Collect data from the instruments that generated those test records.
3. Calculate mean
4. Calculate standard deviation
5. Calculate maximum safe operating pressure limit

## Start with the test records
=============================
[Test records example]

Identify each test record and it's corresponding outcome. The outcome is the result of the test based on how the instrument measuring it interprets whether it passed or failed.

## Collect data from the instruments that generated those test records.
=============================

To evaluate a consumer product's performance, you must start with a number. That number should be the value reported by the instrument measuring the effect of the consumer action causing the tested record.

[Data collection example]

## Calculate mean
================
Calculate the average of the measurements so you can account for failures. 


## Calculate standard deviation
=================================
Calculate a dispersion value. This will help you decide which tests to include in the evaluation.
